adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts` the new `updateEvent` logic sets `selectedCalendar` as `externalCalendarId ? externalCalendarId : event.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)?.externalId;`. This `find` runs only when `externalCalendarId` is falsy, but then compares `cal.externalId === externalCalendarId` where `externalCalendarId` is `undefined`/`null`, so it will almost always return `undefined` (unless a destination calendar has an undefined externalId). Previously this branch used `event.destinationCalendar?.externalId`, so the change removes the intended fallback to the destination calendar and can result in calling Google update with no resolved calendar id.
